case: ~/wind_tunnel/3d_AnimCube (light copy of _anim/Cube: field.npz, forces.json, status only)
solver: OpenFOAM v2512 simpleFoam, k-omega SST, steady, gated at t = 1831
body: cube -1..1 m on every axis, L = 2 m, Blender object AnimCube in scene WT_ANIM
blender: 5.2.0 LTS, add-on 0.4.4 source (Stage 3 code), loaded through wind_tunnel.load3d (open issue f)

scene_colour.bloom: none (EEVEE in 5.2 has no bloom setting)

slice_probes.method: WT Slice evaluated vertex nearest the target, its cp attribute vs trilinear p / q of field.npz at the vertex world position (q = 0.5 * 1.225 * 20^2 = 245 Pa)
slice_probes.note: errors are float32 rounding of the VDB grid; Cp 1.019 at the stagnation probe is open issue c (inlet non-uniformity), not a slice error

particles_inside.method: live WT_ANIM, solved mode (Use Field on, no slide, no push back, still rule kept), frames 1..192 played in order; positions from the instance_transform of the evaluated instances

solid_mask_nearest_node_count_not_gated.note: the closed mask (issue e fix) marks the surface nodes solid, so nearest node flags particles up to half a voxel (0.025 m) outside the wall; none of them is inside the body

smoke_vs_rk4_drift.method: tools/audit/anim_q3_smoke.py mode off, 100 frames, headless factory-startup Blender 5.2, then tools/audit/anim_q3_drift.py (RK4 step dt/24, at most 0.068 voxel at U max), equal arc length over 1 L, 3000 release points; field.npz with the fixed mask
smoke_vs_rk4_drift.previous_mask_for_comparison: Q3 (old mask): near body max 0.062 voxel, freestream 0.008 voxel, 1 box entrant (1.1 mm deep), validation/anim_ab_q3_measure.json

legend_pixels.method: EEVEE still, ortho camera facing +Y, 2200 x 200 px (2 mm per px), filter size 0, PNG 8 bit, Standard view; pixel centre at each stop t = k/8, end stops at the first and last pixel inside the strip (t = 0.00025 and 0.99975)
legend_pixels.reference: endpoints Moreland 2009, Diverging Color Maps for Scientific Visualization; intermediates our Msh implementation (anim.CP_STOPS_SRGB)
